tools.name: preview_start
tools.description: Start finite source preview. A rejected build can leave no frame; inspect diagnostics. Starting a closed session fails.

tools.name: preview_poll
tools.description: Read source changes. Rejected edits retain the previous accepted frame; inspect diagnostics.

tools.name: preview_status
tools.description: Read readiness, lifecycle, frame descriptor and diagnostics. Historical failure does not make a recovered frame stale.

tools.name: preview_frame
tools.description: Read the current accepted allocation. available=false and frame=null before first publication or after close. A rejected edit can retain an older frame; inspect status diagnostics.

tools.name: preview_close
tools.description: Close the session and release its current frame. Repeated close is allowed; restart requires a new server session.

tools.name: preview_refresh
tools.description: Rebuild the current regular valid source even if unchanged; publish a fresh stateless WASM instance after full verification. Failed builds retain the last frame. No user-state migration is supported. Closed sessions fail.
